rules.instruction: When the description makes the time limit or the target of a follow-up action depend on a sequence of yes/no checks applied to the same subject, where each check's result changes the next step: Model each check as its own exclusive gateway, placed in the order the description gives the checks. Give each gateway one labelled outgoing flow per outcome, using the condition wording from the description. Attach each outcome flow to the action or step it triggers, including any stated time limit. Connect the not-taken outcome to the next check or to its own continuation. Do not replace these checks with a single task that assesses the subject, and do not omit a check merely because its outcome only changes a time limit.
rules.situation: the description states a yes/no condition that is checked at a point in time, such as whether a party has already acted, with a consequence that follows if it has not happened after a stated period, and it does not describe several awaited events from which the first one that occurs selects the path

rules.instruction: When the description states that while a waiting period lasts, the actor receives status information or the process performs a stated activity that does not end the wait: Model that ongoing activity as its own task, placed on a branch that runs alongside the wait and starts when the wait starts. Keep the wait itself as a separate event that ends the wait. Do not drop the activity, and do not replace it with the wait event or fold it into the wait's label.
rules.situation: the description states that while a waiting period lasts, the actor receives status information or the process performs a stated activity that does not end the wait

rules.instruction: When the description says that when a required action is not carried out within a stated deadline, an authority or system applies a consequence such as a fine or penalty to the actor: After the timer catch event that marks the deadline, on the branch where the required action was not carried out, model the consequence as a service task that carries out the consequence. Then connect that task to the end event. Do not replace the consequence with an end event named after its outcome, because the description states an action that is performed, not a terminal result.
rules.situation: the description says that when a required action is not carried out within a stated deadline, an authority or system applies a consequence such as a fine or penalty to the actor

rules.instruction: When the description states that a consequence or follow-up step applies only if a required action has not been taken by a stated deadline, and it asks to check the state at that point rather than to react to whichever event occurs first: Model an exclusive gateway that checks the state of the required action at the deadline, with one labelled outgoing flow per answer (action taken or not taken), and attach the consequence to the not-taken flow. Do not model this as an event-based gateway with a timer catch event, and do not add a catch event for the deadline.
rules.situation: the description states that a consequence or follow-up step applies only if a required action has not been taken by a stated deadline, and it asks to check the state at that point rather than to react to whichever event occurs first

rules.instruction: When the description states, in one sentence, several items that the same participant enters or selects, joined by commas or 'and', and each item is a distinct input or choice the participant makes: Model each item in that list as its own user task, in the order the sentence states them, and label each task with the verb and the single item it covers, taken from the description. Do not combine two items into one task label, and do not drop any item from the list.
rules.situation: the description states, in separate sentences, that the same actor records one result and then records another distinct item, such as a follow-up time, and the generated model combines these recordings into one task whose label also covers a message to another party
